summary: Single-resource destructor (__thiscall): loads the resource pointer at this+0x14 (this[5]); when non-null, frees it through FreeWrapper_7bcf and returns that call's result, otherwise returns the null pointer unchanged. Used by array-cleanup and dual-array destructor paths.

operations.description: Load result = this[5] (the resource pointer at this+0x14).
Guard on the loaded this[5] pointer being non-null; when null, skip the free and return the null value.
Invoke FreeWrapper_7bcf(this[5]) to free the resource and return its result.
Return the free call's result, or the unmodified null pointer when the guard was taken.

unresolved: Identity of the owner object and the concrete resource type behind the pointer at this+0x14 are not established by the packet.
The freed object is not cleared from this+0x14 after the free; whether callers rely on that is unknown.
FreeWrapper_7bcf's allocation/free accounting semantics are outside this function's evidence.
